technical_overview: Offered at $32.0 for 30ml, this KoColor SERUM is expertly formulated with Water, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Glycerin, Tocopherol, Sodium Hyaluronate. Delivering a high-fidelity Luminous Glow color profile (`#FFF8E7`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
